HRA Analysis: JEWEL REASON (1) should have the speed to drive through and lead in this race from the ideal draw. She led before sitting on Mullum Sizzle last time out and was able to run a good second to him in a race they dashed up a fast last half. KIDADA LOU (8) should get a good run through in the early stages of this race drawn behind a horse which is likely to be keen to lead. Her third behind Skip To Me Lou looked sharp enough to see her figuring in a race of this nature. HUSTLE AND HOLD (3) showed good gate speed early in a recent trial behind sitting on Franco Not Out and running second to him. She draws well on debut and should be close enough in the run. JUST SONNY (9) led last time out and appeared to over race a touch out in front setting a genuine tempo before fading into fourth behind Go Minnie. He should get a good run off the speed in this race and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: JEWEL REASON (1), KIDADA LOU (8), HUSTLE AND HOLD (3), JUST SONNY (9) SUGGESTED BET: JEWEL REASON (1) to win.

ROSEANNE RUBY (4) sat without cover last time out at Redcliffe and battled on well for fourth behind Britts Mate. She draws to be able to get forward in this race and if she could find the lead she would likely be very hard to run down in a race of this nature. SAYCHELLES (9) secured a good run last time out and briefly looked the winner using the sprint lane to edge past Rollonx before being nabbed on the line late. She should get a good run off the speed in this race and should be running into it late. BEAU STEELE (10) looks set to get a good run through and an economical run in this race off the speed. He was running on late last time out in a race taken out by Rollonx and should get a similar run in this race. MISS HATTIE (7) secured a good run off the speed last time out and was running on well enough into sixth in a stronger race than this one. She will need a few things to go her way from the draw but can figure with the right run. SELECTIONS: ROSEANNE RUBY (4), SAYCHELLES (9), BEAU STEELE (10), MISS HATTIE (7) SUGGESTED BET: ROSEANNE RUBY (4) to win.

DUAL CAM (3) has good gate speed and should be able to press forward and find a prominent position. He elected to hand over last time out at this track and trip and was held up a touch there finishing fifth. MY ULTIMATE VICTOR (2) has good gate speed and may look to find the pegs before having options from there. He handed over to Mahindi at Redcliffe last time out and was able to battle away well for second there. BUBBY TO BASE (7) drew poorly last time out and was making up some late ground into eighth in a stronger race taken out by Our Rocky. She should get a good run off the speed in this race and can be running on late. MACH ASSASSIN (4) trialled up nicely behind smart FFA pacer Captain Shuffles. He should be able to find a prominent position in this race from a good front row draw and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: DUAL CAM (3), MY ULTIMATE VICTOR (2), BUBBY TO BASE (7), MACH ASSASSIN (4) SUGGESTED BET: DUAL CAM (3) to win.

BEACH MAGIC (6) took on a stronger race last time out and was running on late into fourth. He has gate speed and should be able to find a prominent position from a good draw in this race. KEAYANG TARA (3) has gate speed and may elect to press forward and look for the lead in the early stages of the race which is a position she has raced well from previously. She was shuffled back last time out and was running on well late into fifth. PARTY CHANGER (10) was able to work into the clear last time out and flew over the top to win quite comfortably. He should get a similar run in this race and will be hard to hold out late. STONES (4) two starts ago was forced to do some work when battling on well for third behind Jilliby Panda at Marburg. He should be able to press forward and find a prominent position from the good draw and should be thereabouts. SELECTIONS: BEACH MAGIC (6), KEAYANG TARA (3), PARTY CHANGER (10), STONES (4) SUGGESTED BET: KEAYANG TARA (3) to win.

PINKCHAMPAGNE (1) wasn’t suited last time out when attempting to make a wide run into it in a race taken out by Ultimate Hunter. She looks likely to get a lot more favours this time from an ideal draw and if she can lead early she should be hard to run down. ROSIES BOY (8) should get a good run through in this race behind what looks to be the likely leader on paper. He seems to love being driven with a sit and saved for one run late and should be very hard to hold out with any luck in running. ROLLYARRRZ (9) raced without a lot of luck last time out when shuffled back in the early stages of the race before running into traffic at a crucial stage of the race. He should get a good run off the speed this time and can be running on late. ROCKIN SWEET (6) was forced to race without cover last time out before fading out of it late in a race taken out by Denis The Punter. He draws wide again and will need a few things to his way but is capable in this type of race. SELECTIONS: PINKCHAMPAGNE (1), ROSIES BOY (8), ROLLYARRRZ (9), ROCKIN SWEET (6) SUGGESTED BET: ROSIES BOY (8) each way.

GIDUP CAPTAIN (1) has good gate speed and was able to show that last time out to lead taking them all the way at Marburg. He should be able to lead again in this race and can be hard to run down. WHATA GOOD FEELING (7) hasn’t had a lot of luck in recent outings. She got back last time out and was running on late into eighth in a race taken out by Art Jester. BETTOR CHEER (5) ran well two starts ago when finishing a close up third behind Bonnies Cam at this track in decent time for the grade. He draws a touch awkwardly in this race and should be running on again. TAYLORS FOUR (8) should get a good run behind the speed in this race and is likely to be suited by the 2138 journey. She was running on well into sixth last time out. SELECTIONS: GIDUP CAPTAIN (1), WHATA GOOD FEELING (7), BETTOR CHEER (5), TAYLORS FOUR (8) SUGGESTED BET: WHATA GOOD FEELING (7) each way.

STUDLEIGH ANNE (2) has good gate speed and should be able to work to the lead in this race and may elect to hold stepping back in trip. She led last time out before handing over and wasn’t beaten too far behind Goodoldboysandbeer. SPLASHNDASH (4) secured a good run last time out and was well beaten last time out behind Bonnies Cam. He looks reasonably well placed in a race of this nature and should run well. ZAC DANIELS (6) had a tough run last time out in a truly run race and was well beaten as a result. He draws wide again in this race but may find this a touch easier than his latest outing. THE TORQUE EFFECT (1) secured a good run off the speed and was running on late in a race taken out by Delightfully Sweet. She should get a good run behind the speed in this race and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: STUDLEIGH ANNE (2), SPLASHNDASH (4), ZAC DANIELS (6), THE TORQUE EFFECT (1) SUGGESTED BET: STUDLEIGH ANNE (2) to win. BIG REPUTATION (3) did a few things wrong in a recent trial but looked very impressive when scoring nicely. She has the draw advantage on her main rivals in this race and can look to maintain that in the early stages. DOUBLEFAULT (6) was forced to do some work mid race last time out when forging to the lead before being run down late by Go Minnie. He draws wide again in this race but looks one of the better chances. BROADWAYBEAUTY (5) despite being unplaced from five starts she did show good ability on her first campaign including a midfield finishing last time out behind Aardies A Star. She may need some luck from the draw but looks capable. RESERVED FOR ME (2) had things go wrong in a recent trial when running well enough there. She should have derived good benefit from the outing and draws nicely on debut. SELECTIONS: BIG REPUTATION (3), DOUBLEFAULT (6), BROADWAYBEAUTY (5), RESERVED FOR ME (2) SUGGESTED BET: BIG REPUTATION (3) to win.

MAJESTIC LAVROS (5) was able to show good gate speed two starts ago zipping across early and taking them all the way. He comes into this race third up from a spell and is a horse with high speed that has some versatility. KODA DA MODA (4) has gate speed and may look to press forward and find a prominent position in this race. She raced off a 20m handicap last start and was good running into second beating a number of her key rivals in this race. INSTANT DELIGHT (1) has very little gate speed which makes gate 1 quite an awkward draw for her. If she can drive through and hold a prominent position this looks a suitable race. WHIRLWIND WILBUR (2) was quite impressive last time out when leading and winning comfortably from the stand start. He draws nicely in this race and should go well again. SELECTIONS: MAJESTIC LAVROS (5), KODA DA MODA (4), INSTANT DELIGHT (1), WHIRLWIND WILBUR (2) SUGGESTED BET: MAJESTIC LAVROS (5) to win.

SERENA LOVE (3) was forced to work hard last time out before edging to the lead when looking a certain winner before she broke gait in the final 50 and had to settle for third behind SECOND TO NUN (5). She is well handicapped in this race off just 10m and looks very hard to beat if she brings her best manners. LAYDOWNLUNA (7) was able to press through from the back row last time out and find the front finishing a close up second behind SECOND TO NUN (5). The handicaps don’t play into her favour in this race but she has been racing well and should run well again. SECOND TO NUN (5) secured a good run last time out and was able to edge past them late in the race to score. She should settle close enough again and looks another suitable race. GETOVERROVER (11) started off a big handicap three starts ago and was able to prove too good there. He is better handicapped in this race and looks a chance if he can step well early off the more favourable 30m handicap. SELECTIONS: SERENA LOVE (3), LAYDOWNLUNA (7), SECOND TO NUN (5), GETOVERROVER (11) SUGGESTED BET: SERENA LOVE (3) to win.

UNCLE TONY (2) was forced to race without cover last time out at this track and battled on nicely there for third behind Sweet Dior. He should be able to press forward and find the lead in this race and would be very hard to run down from there. GLENEAGLE VEE CEE (3) should get a good run behind the speed in this race. He secured a good run last time out and was running on late into fourth behind Sweet Dior. ROCKS OR DIAMONDS (1) has the perfect draw in this race to sit behind the speed and run into the money. He raced without a lot of luck last time out at Redcliffe when getting back in the run and making a wide run into it behind Pumpkin Pat who led all the way. BETTERTHANPOPSY (7) took on a strong stand start field last time out which was taken out by Greased Lightnin. He looks much better suited in this race and if the race is run to suit he should be running on strongly late. SELECTIONS: UNCLE TONY (2), GLENEAGLE VEE CEE (3), ROCKS OR DIAMONDS (1), BETTERTHANPOPSY (7) SUGGESTED BET: UNCLE TONY (2) to win.

SPORTS BOUNTY (7) was able to get in behind the leader recently at this track and ran out a dominant winner rating fast time for the grade. He looks well placed again in this race and should be hard to beat despite the wide draw. AZOR AHAI (3) has good gate speed and may be able to press forward before having options from there. He was left without cover recently at this track which isn’t generally a position he is suited to racing in. OCTOBER RACKETEER (10) drew awkwardly last time out and was held up for clear running there when finishing eighth. He draws outside the back row in this race which looks awkward but he is capable. THREE CHORD RIFF (1) doesn’t have a lot of gate speed which could see her shuffled back a touch early. She was good three starts ago when running on well into second in the Showcase series at Redcliffe. SELECTIONS: SPORTS BOUNTY (7), AZOR AHAI (3), OCTOBER RACKETEER (10), THREE CHORD RIFF (1) SUGGESTED BET: SPORTS BOUNTY (7) to win.

BART BENTLEY (11) was having his first start for the stable of Mitch Cox last time out and was able to score a very impressive when there when sitting without cover. He may be forced to work again in this race but should run well. TAKE A CHANCE (1) has the good draw in this race and may be able to bounce back. He was shuffled back last time out in a slowly run race and couldn’t get into it late. He should be better suited racing up on speed. POCKET BOOK (7) got back in the run last time out and was running on well into second behind stablemate She Maybe Bettor. She draws widest which could see her shuffled back a long way and will need the race run to suit. LUVN OSMAN (4) was forced to race without cover last time out and battled on strongly there for fourth despite the work he had done in the run. He may be shuffled back in the race and should be running on late. SELECTIONS: BART BENTLEY (11), TAKE A CHANCE (1), POCKET BOOK (7), LUVN OSMAN (4) SUGGESTED BET: BART BENTLEY (11) to win.

CAMERINA (2) looked to be a good thing beaten last time out when losing considerable ground when switching into the clear before charging late and just missing. She has the draw advantage on her main rivals this time and looks hard to beat. RACANA (8) was crossed in the early stages last time out by Opallane and was running on nicely late into a close up second but just wasn’t quite able to reel in the leader. She looks to draw awkward this time and may need a few things to go her way in the run. OUR SWEET JESS (4) secured the perfect run last time out and appeared to have her chance to win there behind Art Jester. She is a horse with high speed and can figure with the right run. UBETONRED (5) scored a dominant win recently at this track when finding the front and leading all the way. He may be forced to do the work this time and should be thereabouts. SELECTIONS: CAMERINA (2), RACANA (8), OUR SWEET JESS (4), UBETONRED (5) SUGGESTED BET: CAMERINA (2) to win. NOTHING I WANT (4) has a handy record from the mobile start and she was a stand start winner last week when she defeated IMA DESTROYER by a neck. She looks hard to beat again today. IMA DESTROYER (5) will prefer the mobile start today and she is racing in some excellent form. PARLEZVOUS PATTY (3) and SILVER SPOON (1) are also chances.

UPRIGHT (4) hasn’t won a race for a little while but he finds the sort of race he can win today. He shouldn’t mind the longer journey and if he can get the right run into the race then he should be able to finish off the race well. BETTOR LOVER (5), NIGHT SPIRIT (1) and GLITZY ALL OVER (2) are all big chances over this distance.

JILLIBY BLISS (5) has been racing well since coming to South Australia. She was a winner four starts ago here at Globe Derby and she has been racing around the mark since then. Today looks like her sort of race. MAGICAL MADGE (3), EMILY MEAGAN (7) and HELPISFARAWAY (1) are all big chances in a very even and tricky race.

OHSO KINKY (1) is first up from a long spell today. She hasn’t had a start since January but her form during her last preparation was encouraging. Her stable and driver must be respected in a race like this. OUR PRINCESS DI (7) looks like the main danger and she has the tricky draw to overcome. MIDNIGHT CRIMES (3) and MANDS PEARL (4) look the next best.

LOCHINVAR HAWK (2) returns from a few weeks off and finds himself in an easier race from a solid draw. If he can show off some of his gate speed then he is a strong chance of leading all of the way. JUST BECCY (4), LIGHTNING BLING (6) and MICKTHEBESTBUTCHER (5) are also chances.

BERSAGLIERE (5) was a last start winner for Aaron Coad in Mildura. He now returns to SA with Ryan Hryhorec in winning form. He is well drawn today and he matches up well against this field. NORMY (8) has been gradually improving here in South Australia and he looks like a big threat today after a strong second last week. WOODVILLE FLYER (6) and BROBENAH GIRL (1) are also chances.

ALORA (4) was a little disappointing last start at Port Pirie after her dominant win at Gawler the start prior when she defeated HASTY BID by 18.3 meters. She will enjoy being back at Globe Derby today where she has a strong record. HASTY BID (5) could be a big improver today if he can receive the right run. RUTHLESS OFFENDER (7) and HAPPY AS CAN BE (2) are also chances.

WHITESTARCHRISTIAN (3) hasn’t won a race in a long time but he finds an easy race today. He also could find the lead today. He is worth strong each way consideration. DONT TELL ALICE (4) has a great strike rate for Danielle Hill and today looks like a race he could win. PARISIAN BANDIT (5) and LOCHINVAR RULER (6) are also chances.

TUFFASNAILS (4) ran as a short priced favourite last start and was beaten by 2.5 meters behind SWEETKINDOFMAGIC. He finds an easier race today and he has been showing signs of improvement since coming to SA. He looks like the one to beat. PARADIGM (9), DASHING COWBOY (1) and ROAD STAR (6) are also chances. OVERVIEW: OZZIE DIAMOND (3) is a maiden taking on more experienced horses who have already won races, but she has been racing better than her numerical form suggests. She finished fifth in the Vicbred Super Series heat two starts ago behind Ideal Frankie before being a late scratching from the semi-final. She raced well last start at Mildura but was checked late. She has the best sectional times in this event. BLUE CANNON (1) ran home well last start at this track despite racing wide. He should get a much better trip from the fence here and, being third-up, should be close to peak fitness. IAMAWINGATE (8) is racing well and, with the right trip, has the turn of foot to flash home late. TREACHEROUSTIMES (5) has the gate speed and turn of foot to put himself in a competitive position early. BACK: OZZIE DIAMOND (3) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:OZZIE DIAMOND (3), BLUE CANNON (1), IAMAWINGATE (8), TREACHEROUSTIMES (5)

OVERVIEW: SHEER ME (4) is second-up here for new trainer Alex Ashwood. She ran well at Melton last start in good time, leading and only being beaten narrowly late. She should take improvement from that performance. MYSTIC MOTIVER (2) is a lightly raced mare having just her fifth career start. She is first-up here, but she performed well last campaign and should continue to improve with experience. She will likely map well here. SPOT THE DEVIL (9) is third up here for new trainer Mark Watson. He is racing ok and gets a good barrier to map well here.DYGANALI (6) got well back last start but ran home OK. She is racing well and looks close to breaking through for her maiden victory. ZEE HOUTEN (5) is having her second career start but hasn’t raced since September 2024. Her recent trial form has been good, but race fitness could be a query from the barrier here. BACK: SHEER ME (4) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:SHEER ME (4), MYSTIC MOTIVER (2), SPOT THE DEVIL (9),DYGANALI (6)

OVERVIEW: SOHO PLAYGIRL (7) flashed home to win impressively by a nice margin two starts ago at Shepparton. Last start, she was held up late but let down well once she found clear running. Barrier seven makes it challenging, but she has the class to overcome it. THE NIGHT FOX (4) is second-up here after arriving from New Zealand. In his first-up run, he got stuck in the breeze and raced keenly before tiring late. He’s been back to the trials since, where he has been OK, and he should improve with that run under his belt. POPCORNFRIDAY (8) is first-up here but has options being the only horse on the second row. His last few runs before going for a spell were strong, and he should get his chance to settle early. OUR CHEEKY DEVIL (5) is stepping out for start 214. He’s an experienced horse with a great turn of foot. He’s racing well but has an awkward barrier to overcome. SELECTIONS: SOHO PLAYGIRL (7), THE NIGHT FOX (4), POPCORNFRIDAY (8), OUR CHEEKY DEVIL (5)

OVERVIEW: MELICAN (3) has had the one career start, which was a brilliant victory at Hobart, winning by 25.2 metres. She was very green in the run, galloping and racing roughly. She is first-up in Victoria for Rebecca Bartley. She should perform well, but her manners are a query against more experienced mares. OZZIE TART (5) and QUEENHIGH FLUSH (2) are both speedy beginners who will likely look to map positively early. OZZIE TART (5) was a good fifth in the Group 1 Vicbred Super Series Final two starts ago, but got it wrong with her manners at Mildura last start after jumping a shadow. That run is easy to forgive, and she will be looking to bounce back here. QUEENHIGH FLUSH (2) is in good form and gets the benefit of what should be a favourable race map here. FOUR EVER A STAR (1) is on the comeback after a few years on the sidelines. This is her fifth start back, and she’s getting better with each run. She has a good barrier here. SELECTIONS:MELICAN (3), OZZIE TART (5), QUEENHIGH FLUSH (2), FOUR EVER A STAR (1)

OVERVIEW: LITTLE MISS MORGAN (2) is a talented trotter who is still figuring out her race manners. She was a brilliant third behind superstar mares Gatesys Gem and Jilliby Dreamlover two starts back in the Vicbred Super Series heat. In the Group 1 Final, she hit the line well but was too far back. This is an easier race. ABBIE (7) is second-up here and should improve with fitness after her tough first-up run. She is a smart mare on her day, but she has an awkward barrier. VOLDAGHA (3) is another runner who is second-up here. Last start, he was beaten 14.6 metres behind the smart Muskee, and he should improve with fitness here. CHAMPAGNES (8) is a fast trotting mare who has had a brilliant, career-best 12 months of racing. This would be one of her toughest tests, but she is the only horse on the back row, so she has space to settle early. Also respecting MAJESTIC MONARCH (1) from the barrier. BACK: LITTLE MISS MORGAN (2) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:LITTLE MISS MORGAN (2), ABBIE (7), VOLDAGHA (3), CHAMPAGNES (8).

OVERVIEW: MONEY TALKS (7) is only a two-time winner, but he’s consistent and rarely runs a bad race. He flashed home well from last to finish third last start and, with some luck, he can be flashing home again here. BETSY ANNE (4) has the gate speed to be tactical early and hopefully find a good position. She struggled a little last start at Charlton, but her runs prior were good and she looks ready to get back into the winner’s circle. CHARLIE WALKER (6) was a good winner when leading three starts back. He’s been performing well since and also has the gate speed to map well here. NUCLEAR ATTITUDE (5) is another consistent performer who rarely puts in a bad run. If he finds some luck, he’s a first-four chance here. SELECTIONS:MONEY TALKS (7), BETSY ANNE (4), CHARLIE WALKER (6), NUCLEAR ATTITUDE (5)

OVERVIEW: SILENT REVERIE (5) is a trotter who is racing well. She should have enough gate speed to find the front here and be hard to beat from there. She rarely races at Kilmore, but she has won at the track in one of her few attempts. AHUNDREDPLUS (6) is second-up here and should improve from her first-up seventh at Melton in a tougher race. The barrier is awkward, but the smaller field should help. CADENCE LANE (4) ran home well for a good third at Charlton last start. She is a nice horse at her best and looks close to returning to her best form. SABIHALIL (1) has the ace barrier and should get a good fence trip here. BACK: SILENT REVERIE (5) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:SILENT REVERIE (5), AHUNDREDPLUS (6), CADENCE LANE (4), SABIHALIL (1) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW: It is a very good start to the program with the return of the star local pacer MY ULTIMATE JIMMY (4) taking on the smart Aaron Dunn trained pacers MAXY WANTS TO PLAY (3) and HOT DEAL (6). MY ULTIMATE JIMMY (4) won a heat of the Mildura Cup in April and boasts the record of nine wins from nineteen starts on the track including several victories in mile rates of better than 1.55.0. He won a trial at Mildura last week and should make his presence felt. HOT DEAL (6) also boasts an exceptional strike rate at Mildura (11 of 27) and he came out three horses wide from eighth at the bell when a big winner last outing. He is very versatile and should prove hard to beat again. MAXY WANTS TO PLAY (3) trailed forward behind HOT DEAL (6) in the final lap and tried hard in the straight when a close second behind that pacer last time out. He is better drawn for this assignment and is worth thought again. PRIORITISE (5) was resuming since July when a creditable fourth behind Dhaulagiri at Mildura last outing. He should be fitter from that run and is capable of running into a place. BACK: - MY ULTIMATE JIMMY (4) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: MY ULTIMATE JIMMY (4), HOT DEAL (6), MAXY WANTS TO PLAY (3), PRIORITISE (5)

OVERVIEW:ALWAYS ON SAFARI (1) began quickly from the outside of the front line to race without cover early, gained the one out and one back trail behind CALF PEN (3) mid-race and battled on fairly well for third at Mildura last outing. He is better drawn for this assignment and should be prominent throughout. LOUIEVILLE (8) is resuming since a seventh at Mildura in June but he will take beating if he is somewhere near his peak. He was competitive against stronger opposition when he was last in work. SHIRLEY NOT (2) worked home nicely to win two weeks ago then was making ground through the middle approaching the home turn but struck a sulky wheel and galloped at her latest unlucky ninth. She is worth another chance from her good draw. CALF PEN (3) circled around the field to race without cover and proved to be too strong at Mildura on Friday. That was his best run for a long time and he will go close again if he can repeat that performance. SELECTIONS: ALWAYS ON SAFARI (1), LOUIEVILLE (8), SHIRLEY NOT (2), CALF PEN (3)

OVERVIEW: KYORETSU (7) recorded successive victories at Mildura and Globe Derby prior to a third behind Neatntidy on Friday, where he began quickly from a wide draw and was able to angle in behind the leader on the first turn. He is awkwardly drawn but appears to be well placed against this opposition. UNITED (8) settled three back on the markers and couldn’t pick up over the latter stages when fifth in the same race won by Neatntidy last week. This is a drop back in class and he was an impressive winner over Lewielewis (won since) on August 07 so he is worth another chance. MY ULTIMATE BILLY (2) performed below expectations at Mildura on Friday, where he raced without cover early before gaining the one out and one back trail. He is better than that effort suggests and is capable of showing up from his good draw. RIO ROCK (1) should be getting fitter after having two starts back from a break and is perfectly drawn to suit her racing pattern so she could improve on her numerical form. BACK: KYORETSU (7) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: KYORETSU (7), UNITED (8), MY ULTIMATE BILLY (2), RIO ROCK (1)

OVERVIEW: ALMIGHTY RUSH (2) is a fast beginner and is a good chance of leading throughout. He attempted for an all of the way victory when second behind Pretty Mischievous over the 2190m at Mildura on September 11 and he will take catching over the sprint distance. LIKE A LIBRARIAN (10) was held up for a run at a vital stage and worked home okay for fifth at Mildura on Friday. She has been finding the line nicely in her recent appearances and appears to be suited against this line up. PHILS BOY (7) met a stronger field at Charlton when on debut and ran an even race for sixth in a mile of 1.58.2. He should have benefited from the experience and is worth thought under these conditions. CRUEL MISTRESS (9) was placed three times in succession in early August and hasn’t been far away at her recent performances. She is awkwardly drawn but is capable of running into a place. BACK: ALMIGHTY RUSH (2) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: ALMIGHTY RUSH (2), LIKE A LIBRARIAN (10), PHILS BOY (7), CRUEL MISTRESS (9)

OVERVIEW:FLEUR BELLA (2) led throughout in a victory over PUNTO CALIENTE (3) at Mildura on September 11 and is drawn to find the lead again. She didn’t run on over the latter stages at Mildura on Friday but she moves to the front line now and should give a bold showing. PUNTO CALIENTE (3) came from behind FLEUR BELLA (2) and beat that pacer to the line on Friday. He is racing consistently and deserves to break through for a win. THE DEVIL ROLLS ON (9) settled eighth on the outside, came out three horses wide from the 600m and finished off well for third behind Ned’s Beach at Mildura last outing. She is racing consistently and is worth a ticket each way. SNEAKY PHILTRA (4) was making ground out very wide on the track before locking wheels on the home turn when unplaced last week. She was racing really well during June/July and the move to the front line is a definite advantage so she might be able to return to some form. ROJENBYE (6), INDIANAS SON (7) and CAPTAIN PAPRIKA (8) are all capable of showing up in an open race. SELECTIONS: FLEUR BELLA (2), PUNTO CALIENTE (3), THE DEVIL ROLLS ON (9), SNEAKY PHILTRA (4)

OVERVIEW: HOOKLINEANDSINKER (2) ran a much sharper race second up on Friday when he attempted to lead throughout and finished second. He is drawn to lead again and should take catching over the sprint distance. BOHEMIAN BRAIDS (1) was driven aggressively early and battled on well for second behind Ned’s Beach at Mildura two starts ago. He endured a tough run on the outside of the leader last week and he should gain an economical trip from the pole position so he is not without a chance. ACCELERE (7) will need luck from the inside of the second line but he is racing in great form having been placed in all of his five starts since returning to Victoria. He led throughout at Mildura victory two starts ago then followed with a third in a handy mile rate of 1.58.6. BAZZAS LEGACY (8) competed in the Mildura Guineas on Friday and this race is a lot easier. He finished third in reasonable time at Mildura prior and looms as one of the leading chances. COME ON BILLEE (6) had no clear run and seemed to have something in reserve at his latest unlucky fourth. He is worth thought despite the wide draw. BACK: HOOKLINEANDSINKER (2) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: HOOKLINEANDSINKER (2), BOHEMIAN BRAIDS (1), ACCELERE (7), BAZZAS LEGACY (8)

OVERVIEW:ASSIGNED (2) comes here off a strong win at Kilmore where he was able to lead all the way comfortably after getting control and dashing home. He had a flat tyre prior to that and three back here was favourite and was a little plain, to be fair, from the same draw. The map is favourable for him again to roll forward over the short trip and take some catching. OWEN THE SAINTS (5) has been racing in terrific form of late, winning 2 from 4, and has been versatile in those performances. There’s speed underneath him, but if he can get a nice map, he will be strong late. JILLIBY ILLUSION (3) was well supported into odds-on favourite last start at Maryborough, and although she looked to have her chance, they did run time there. She’s a chance again from the favourable draw. DEMBE (1) is a last-start winner at Wagga where he sat parked and was too good, in what seemed a weaker race than he meets here. The soft draw and good map will give him every chance. RONNIE THE HAMMER (4) is an interesting runner, first up from a break off two average trials. He is a horse who’s shown nice ability in stronger races than this, so any market push creates interest. The chances don’t end there, with KING SAINT (7) and INTERPRETATION (11) both racing well; they just have tricky draws to overcome. SELECTIONS:ASSIGNED (2), OWEN THE SAINTS (5), JILLIBY ILLUSION (3), DEMBE (1)

OVERVIEW:MAURLEN COMPASS (9) when she’s been on her best behaviour has turned in some very nice performances this season. She was a winner at this track in July and since then took on the best in her age group in the Vicbred Series, where she ran a cracking race in the consolation with a fast-finishing second and her sectionals very good. She’s an out-of-the-draw runner, but if she begins safely, she will be powerful at the finish. FLOPPA (3) can begin well from this favourable draw and map well, and he’s been in solid form this preparation. He was favourite here three back, just missing from behind the leader, then led all the way in good time at Wagga. He’s yet to win at this track or distance, but with the right run will give cheek. IM DUSTEE (6) is 2nd up from a break and he was quite good first up, where he settled well back in the field and found the line strongly. He boasts a solid strike rate at this track and, although he will need some luck from the draw, he looks well suited. HELLO POSSUMS (5) should be fitter now third up and can improve on her numerical form. The map didn’t work out first up, then she stepped up in grade in the Vicbred Series and ran okay in the heat. Her best is good enough. MASTER MIKI (7) and LEONARD (8) are both racing well but have awkward draws to overcome. SELECTIONS:MAURLEN COMPASS (9), FLOPPA (3), IM DUSTEE (6), HELLO POSSUMS (5)

OVERVIEW:OUR MYSTERY BET (3) has been in terrific form, placing 10 from 12 with seven of those top-two finishes. Furthermore, he’s rarely had a good draw in those performances, and now lobs straight into the running line from the favourable draw. He grinds into his work, so if he can map close enough to the lead, he can be strong late. KRISSY (8) turned in an excellent run last start at Charlton where she was able to lead in a quick first section and show heart in the finish to win well. She has a tricky draw to overcome, but a repeat of that run has her well in it. AUSSIE JAY MAC (11) did things wrong last time but still ran well to finish 3rd. His win prior was very good when he was able to lead all the way and ran time. He will give them a start but has ability to overcome setbacks. MADAM REACTOR (9) is often never far away in these sorts of races and will trail through to be in a striking position. She’s in the mix coming with one run late. UNCLE TREV (6) has been close up without winning his past few, but he can show good gate speed and look for the top. He’s yet to win at this track, but this race appears suitable. BACK: OUR MYSTERY BET (3)– 1.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:OUR MYSTERY BET (3), KRISSY (8), AUSSIE JAY MAC (11),MADAM REACTOR (9)

OVERVIEW: ALDEBARAN DENBAY (5) is aiming for a hat-trick here, after bringing his best manners his past couple and showing his ability for the new stable. He was a winner two back when coming with one run, then was able to lead all the way last time out from a similar draw. If he brings that form, he’s clearly the one to beat. THE CHOOK (6) was runner-up in that race and found the line well, driven cold. She is a four-time winner at this track and can slide across with them and map within striking distance. CADENCE LANE (9) turned in a nice effort last time for a third, and Herbertson goes aboard with a potentially soft enough map to be given her chance to find the line well. I AM HARRO (7) faces a challenge from the wide draw, but his past few runs have had merit and, if the map works out, is in the mix again. Minor chances go to BET BET HOTSHOT (1), STARLIGHT RED (2) and HOLD THAT MAGIC (11), who are all capable of improvement with the right runs. BACK: ALDEBARAN DENBAY (5)– 1.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:ALDEBARAN DENBAY (5), THE CHOOK (6), CADENCE LANE (9), I AM HARRO (7)

OVERVIEW: A very good-quality 2yo race with several runners already showing talent. INDULGEME (6) deserves another chance based on his two career performances, the first where he was well backed at this track but raced roughly at key stages, and last time out was $1.25 favourite and, although he went down, it was probably due to focussing in the straight and he beat the rest by a space. If he brings his manners, he can map better than his main back-row rivals. POSTER COMMAND (10) looked impressive in winning on debut at Bathurst where he was able to lead all the way comfortably and ran decent time. He goes to the back row and does meet strong opposition, but you must respect the stable travelling for this assignment. ONELOOK (11) comes through the Vicbred Series where she ran well in the finals considering the challenge she faced from the draw. Prior to that she was racing well, and although she’ll need the right tempo, the ability is clearly there. LACE AND LEATHER (9) defeated the top pick on debut when able to secure a good run in transit and backed up that performance with a close-up 2nd last time when able to lead. Gets a different set-up now but must be respected. OUR MAIN MAN (4) is a newcomer from NSW who is hard to get a handle on but is a market watch. BACK: INDULGEME (6)– 2.5 units (win) SELECTIONS: INDULGEME (6), POSTER COMMAND (10), ONELOOK (11), LACE AND LEATHER (9)

OVERVIEW: CORBIE LADIR (2) is a 2yo having his second career start after turning in a nice effort on debut where, although he went down as a short favourite, he had to work hard to find the top in the early stages, only failing narrowly and beating the rest by a space. He will derive benefit from that outing and can go one better from this set-up. WHERES WOOD WOOD (9) was a good winner here two back when able to lead and run away from a moderate line-up. She backed that up with a solid run from a tricky draw last time. She’s in the mix again. BETTER DOO (1) is having its first run for the new stable and trialled okay recently for this. The draw is soft and looks to get the right map and is worth keeping safe. ALLHEARTNOHEIGHT (8) was a winner five back at Melton with Herbertson in the sulky, but since hasn’t recaptured that form. The soft draw gives her claims. KRAKEY (7) and DOT BALL (10) have minor claims at best, having to overcome tough draws over the short trip. BACK: CORBIE LADIR (2)– 2.5 units (win) SELECTIONS: CORBIE LADIR (2), WHERES WOOD WOOD (9), BETTER DOO (1), ALLHEARTNOHEIGHT (8)

OVERVIEW:ARRAPS (3) failed as favourite last start, but in his defence, not much went right with the map and having to work at various stages. He’s a completely different horse when he’s able to use his speed and find the pegs, which there’s a high likelihood of here. He has a good record at this track and distance and can bounce back against this line-up. SHEZABLUECHIP (5) was able to lead and win from the pole draw last time where she was given every chance against a moderate field. She races well at this track and may map okay. THE LADYBIRD (4) comes through that race and ran okay to finish 5th. She is a winner at this track and should get a soft enough map to be in the mix. FAKE CULLECTION (6) was a winner here last week when given an economical trip and flashed late. This looks a different set-up but has place claims. BERYLS BOOTS (8) has been racing much better his past few, and goes to the back row now but has minor claims. BACK: ARRAPS (3)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: ARRAPS (3), SHEZABLUECHIP (5), THE LADYBIRD (4), BERYLS BOOTS (8)

OVERVIEW:DELIZIOSO (6) is an above-average 3yo filly returning from a long break off two solid trials into this. Her four career runs have yielded quality performances, including a rich classic as a 2yo. She will no doubt benefit from the outing being off such a long spell, but her class will carry her a long way. LA SMOOCH (4) is also first up and came through the same trial recently and went well. She has the barrier draw advantage to press forward, and was a good winner back in April which shapes as good form for this. ARTIES COURAGE (1) is a 3yo filly having her first start and her most recent trial win holds her in good stead. The soft barrier draw guarantees a soft map, and although this is a test to win her maiden, she has claims. ROMBARO (5) comes through the Vicbred Series where he made the final at big odds and was safely held in the final. He’s progressing in a positive direction, so isn’t without a hope. SELECTIONS:DELIZIOSO (6), LA SMOOCH (4), ARTIES COURAGE (1), ROMBARO (5)

OVERVIEW:GYM QUEEN (2) is an 11-start maiden but finds a suitable race to break through here, drawn well to use her gate speed and take up a forward controlling position. She’s run 2nd on four occasions, but if she gets the likely lap to lead without much pressure, she will take plenty of running down. MI BOW (1) is a 36-start maiden who likewise gets a great chance to break through courtesy of a great draw where she’s likely to trail the speed and get her chance. She’s also been going well enough; it will come down to the fortitude to want to stick her neck out. OVER HERE (3) had her first start last week and ran reasonably, despite having every chance. She will likely drop to the peg line for an economical run and attempt to do her best work late. SPESHAL (7) ran 3rd here last week, and she has shown glimpses of ability. She can be a little unreliable in her manners, which limits confidence, however. SELECTIONS:GYM QUEEN (2), MI BOW (1), OVER HERE (3), SPESHAL (7)

OVERVIEW: Very tricky finish with not much quality form to draw upon. GOODTIME MAE (5) drops slightly in grade from what she’s faced recently, and her SP profile in some of those recent runs carries weight. She has gate speed, and having the best driver in the country aboard is a massive plus in a line-ball decision. JOEYS HANGOVER (3), like the rest of these, is winless in 2026, but this looks like his best chance to break that run of outs. He’s not been far away in a number of runs this season, and fitter now 2nd up can go close. GO GEORGE GO (1) will be doing his best to hold up and make use of barrier 1 and look for control. His last couple of runs have been good enough to take a race like this out. His stablemate STELLAR QUEEN (2) ran 2nd two back at Melton from an inside draw, and in all hasn’t been too far off them the past couple of months. She should look for the peg line and conserve for one run late. SELECTIONS:GOODTIME MAE (5), JOEYS HANGOVER (3), GO GEORGE GO (1), STELLAR QUEEN (2)

OVERVIEW:JILLIBY NITRO (9) is resuming since a fifth at Maryborough in May. He was a multiple Country Cups winner earlier in the season and he blitzed his rivals at the trials on Tuesday night so he should prove hard to beat. SWEET IDEAL (8) is a top mare that is a good chance of completing a hat trick. She sustained a long run from the 600m mark when she scored at Terang last outing and was a comfortable winner at Menangle prior. ROADMASTER (7) has been unplaced in both of his starts since resuming but he had little luck in the straight behind Catch A Wave in the open class event at Melton last outing and will find this race to be easier. TELEMACHUS (2) is a fast beginner and did well from the outside of the second line at his latest fourth. He has claims along with GUNFORHIRE (3) and ULTIMATE VINNIE (10). SELECTIONS: JILLIBY NITRO (9), SWEET IDEAL (8), ROADMASTER (7), TELEMACHUS (2)

OVERVIEW:MAGELLAN (11) performed gallantly throughout the Super Series, where fifth in the Final behind the star filly Bettor Beach, after she was held up for a run at a vital stage. She will appreciate a drop back in class for this assignment and should prove hard to beat. JILLIBY ZUCCHINI (6) is resuming since an unplaced effort at Penrith in December 2024 but she won a trial at Terang last week. She has won two of her four starts to date, including a victory at Menangle so she must be respected. GUARANTEED TROUBLE (3) finished fast to defeat War Zone in a slick mile of 1.55.4 at Cranbourne then attempted to lead throughout at his latest second. He is drawn to receive every chance and has claims. BATTON ROUGE (4) is an interesting runner. He has only had one run since February 2025 and that effort was a third behind the smart pacer Mount Barker Boy in July. He has the ability to be competitive against this grade despite the recent lack of racing. BACK: MAGELLAN (11) – 1 unit (win) SELECTIONS: MAGELLAN (11), JILLIBY ZUCCHINI (6), GUARANTEED TROUBLE (3), BATTON ROUGE (4)

OVERVIEW: THEROUX (10) hasn’t had much luck at his most recent appearances and is capable of improving on his numerical form. He sustained a flat tyre and was able to run into fourth at Kilmore then did well to finish as close as he did after making an early error at Ballarat. TORQUEINTHEUSA (9) recently dropped back into this grade and he is picking up his form. He finished fourth behind the smart juvenile Farroh Joe at Stawell then worked home well for third at Charlton. TORQUE IN HEAVEN (8) is awkwardly drawn but has struck peak form with successive victories at Maryborough and Stawell. He finished off well from midfield and won easily last time out so he is worth thought again. FIRESIDE (2) was uncharacteristically slow into stride and finished unplaced in fast time at Ballarat on Wednesday night. This race is easier and he recorded a mile rate of 1.57.9 when he scored on August 26 so he is not without a chance from his good draw. SELECTIONS: THEROUX (10), TORQUEINTHEUSA (9), TORQUE IN HEAVEN (8), FIRESIDE (2)

OVERVIEW: HEAVENLY GEM (2) is a promising maiden and performed extremely well during the Super Series, which culminated with a third behind Kahula in the Final. She is versatile and gets her chance to break through for a deserved victory. JILLIBY ECLIPSE (5) delivered a powerful performance when she dashed home in a slick last half of 56.7 seconds and scored by a big margin at Kilmore on Thursday night. She must be considered as one of the leading chances again. HOSO MAGIC (1) has been unplaced in all of his four starts to date but three attempts were during the Super Series and he competed in the Youthful Stakes when on debut so he is likely to find this assignment to be more suitable. JILLIBY SNIPER (8) was driven aggressively to find the lead when he scored in a mile rate of 1.55.8 at Horsham then his past two attempts were in Super Series events. He is a handy colt that cannot be underestimated. MISS ADELIA (6) battled on well after parking without cover on debut then obtained the perfect trip and scored via the sprint lane at Charlton. This is a race of more depth but she has claims. BACK: HEAVENLY GEM (2) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: HEAVENLY GEM (2), JILLIBY ECLIPSE (5), HOSO MAGIC (1), JILLIBY SNIPER (8)

OVERVIEW:DISPERSION (3) commenced from the inside of the second line, settled four back on the markers and was held up for a run at a vital stage before storming home late for an eye-catching third in the Super Series Silver Pace on debut. He appears to have a promising future and appears to be very hard to beat. KEAYANG HUSTLER (8) is an interesting runner. He is bred to be a very handy trotter but he has been performing nicely as a pacer at the trials so he must be kept safe. IDEAL HIGH (2) is a first starter for trainer Matthew Craven, which finished third at a Terang trial effort last week (Keayang Hustler second) and is drawn to go well. WICKED TORQUE (1) was very wide on the home turn and worked into third at her latest performance. She should gain an economical trip from the pole position and is capable of filling a place again. BACK: - DISPERSION (3) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: DISPERSION (3), KEAYANG HUSTLER (8), IDEAL HIGH (2), WICKED TORQUE (1)

OVERVIEW:KEAYANG LAVITA (8) is clearly the class runner of the field but can she overcome a big handicap of 60m? She won from the standing start at Terang on August 30 and she worked hard when fifth behind Ruby’s Dream in a slick mile rate of 1.56.2 at Melton last outing. A small field and the long trip is in her favour so she cannot be left out of calculations. KEAYANG MINNESOTA (4) broke stride early at her only standing start performance, which is a concern but she will prove hard to beat if she can step away safely. She left a trailing position to park without cover from the 1500m when a brave second behind Adelaide Red two starts ago. SOLOTREKK (5) made an early error and settled last on the markers when unplaced at Ballarat last outing. His form prior was sound and he is worth another chance. SONARMI JOH (6) is a standing start specialist that is racing consistently and is capable of filling a place again. SELECTIONS: KEAYANG LAVITA (8), KEAYANG MINNESOTA (4), SOLOTREKK (5), SONARMI JOH (6)

OVERVIEW: MISSMALACHITE (6) settled midfield on the outside, came out three horses wide from the 500m and finished off solidly for a close second behind Shezabluechip at Charlton. She is a fast beginner and should be competitive again. THE REGULATOR (5) trailed the leader and had every chance when third at Terang last outing but he was a winner at Cranbourne on July 19 and his overall form is strong enough to suggest he is one of the leading chances here. ZWICK (8) led throughout at a Terang victory four starts ago. This race is of similar standard so he is worth an investment. DANCIN WITH ELVIS (3) and DI ANGELO (7) are both capable of showing up in an evenly balanced field. SELECTIONS: MISSMALACHITE (6), THE REGULATOR (5), ZWICK (8), DANCIN WITH ELVIS (3)

OVERVIEW: SAVON DE ROCHE (7) is poorly drawn but she has returned from a spell in outstanding form having been placed in all of her five starts (2 wins). She was driven aggressively and outstayed the smart pacer KEAYANG VIPER (4) at Horsham on July 27 so she must be considered as a winning chance again. KEAYANG VIPER (4) is backing up quickly from her effort at Kilmore on Thursday night but she boasts a very good strike rate and is a good chance of working to the front shortly after the start so a bold showing is expected. ALL BLAZING GUNS (5) will appreciate a drop back in class for this assignment and was placed behind the classy mare Sweet Ideal two starts ago. He possesses a dynamic turn of speed and warrants respect. STARZINHEREYES (3) set up a genuine tempo at Echuca when second on Tuesday night and is worth thought along with CLARA ROCKS (6), which competed in a strong race at Melton when returning from New South Wales. BACK: SAVON DE ROCHE (7) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: SAVON DE ROCHE (7), KEAYANG VIPER (4), ALL BLAZING GUNS (5), STARZINHEREYES (3)

OVERVIEW: TAURAS (5) is still learning but he has ability when he is able to put it altogether and will take beating if he delivers a fool proof display. He was a runaway trial winner at Geelong last week and he did well to finish as close as he did after making several errors at his latest race track appearance. VIXAN (6) was well beaten in two starts during the Super Series but this is a huge drop back in class and she is capable of showing improvement. GAELIC LADY (4) is a first starter for trainer Jason Ainsworth, which was runner up at a Ballarat trial in a mile rate of 1.59.5 on Wednesday so she should go well against this line up. GLOBAL ELITE (2) gained a nice trail and tried hard when second behind Queen of the Summit on debut then was restrained to a rearward position after being caught without cover early at her latest fifth. She cannot be dismissed from her good draw. SELECTIONS: TAURAS (5), VIXAN (6),GAELIC LADY (4), GLOBAL ELITE (2)
